verdict.rationale: Token2 keys are documented as standards-compliant FIDO2/WebAuthn/U2F authenticators with explicit, detailed Microsoft Entra ID/Active Directory integration guides and provisioning tools, plus a generic browser-based WebAuthn demo showing register/login flows. However, there is no explicit documentation or evidence of compatibility/testing with Google accounts, GitHub, or specific password managers — the story's named services are only partially covered. Missing for 10: explicit Google account 2FA setup guide, GitHub security-key registration guide, and named password-manager (e.g., Bitwarden, 1Password) compatibility confirmation.
